title: zesty charred midnight craving japanese monkfish nabemono
description: a charred and crisp pescatarian nabemono dish featuring monkfish, served with a zesty dipping sauce. this dish is perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: season the monkfish with salt and pepper.
grill the monkfish for 2-3 minutes per side, or until charred.
transfer the monkfish to a plate and let it rest.
in a small saucepan, combine the mirin, soy sauce, sake, brown sugar, and grated ginger.
bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
stir in the green onions and cook for an additional minute.
to assemble the dish, place a portion of the grilled monkfish in a mason jar.
pour the hot sauce over the monkfish, then sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
serve immediately, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
cool the dish to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing.
